description: Create a new ABAP package in SAP system. Packages are containers for development objects and are essential for organizing code.

description.description: Package description. If not provided, package_name will be used.

detail.description: How much of the answer to return: "terse" (default, the fields you need to act), "full" (the whole parse), "raw" (the document as ADT sent it).

master_language.description: Optional master/original language for the created object (e.g. "EN", "DE", "ZH"). Defaults to the session language (SAP_LANGUAGE) or EN.

record_changes.description: Enable change recording for the package. Required for transportable packages. Default: false.

software_component.description: Software component. If not provided, SAP will set a default.

super_package.description: Parent package name. Required for structure packages.

transport_layer.description: Transport layer. Required for transportable packages.

transport_request.description: Transport request number, not a task. Required if the package is transportable.

name: CreatePackage
